item.title: How to break up an AIFF file into 1 second chunks
item.description:
• Draft created: Nov 5, 2026 04:59 (UTC). 
    ffmpeg -i input.aif -f segment -segment_time 1 output_%03d.aif
  • or 0.25 for 1/4 second chunks etc etc :-)

item.title: Tools for support folks that should come out of the box but never do :-) part 8888 Espanso and Keyboard Shortcuts (AutoHotKey on Windows, built-in app on macOS) for github issues, bugzilla links, etc etc :-)
item.description:
Discovered: Nov 4, 2026 14:29 (UTC) Tools for support folks that should come out of the box but never do :-) part 8888 Espanso and Keyboard Shortcuts (AutoHotKey on Windows, built-in app on macOS) for github issues, bugzilla links, etc etc :-)

Heavily customized for my needs but easily customized to yours :-) :

  • :hamburger for Thunderbird app menu SUMO KB markup
  • :warmgreet for a randomly picked greeting
  • :warmclose for a randomly picked closing
  • Command+Control+z for a Zendesk ticket link For this and the following links, if you also hold down shift i.e. Shift+Command+Control+z it will do HTML links as well as markdown links
  • Command+Control+y for a Notion link
  • Command+Control+g for a Github issue link
  • Command+Control+u for a Bugzilla bug link
  • Command+Control+l for a link to a page where our cursor is focused like this in Markdown [title of current tab )[url of tab]

item.title: sumo-lint — check support.mozilla.org Knowledge Base markup, fix markup and save to a file. Also a KB markup LSP, Visual Code extension and vi er vim and emacs modes
item.description:
Discovered: Nov 3, 2026 15:07 (UTC) sumo-lint — check support.mozilla.org Knowledge Base markup, fix markup and save to a file. Also a KB markup LSP, Visual Code extension and vi er vim and emacs modes <– Another SUMO tool that I “wrote”. SUMO markup is a variant of wikitet aka mediawiki syntax aka the markup used for wikipedia and wiki.mozilla.org

  • I haven’t tested vim and emacs much :-) #HelpWanted :-) Keeping them in case MS breaks Visual Code or does something silly with it. Plus I have been using vi since 1985 and emacs since 1989 so lots of sentimental value in them for this silly grumpy old person :-)

item.title: Highly recommended: cardamon bun and pourover at Café Olive in Quebec City discovered in The Sprudge Guide To Coffee In Quebec City, Aug 2025
item.description:
Discovered: Oct 30, 2026 14:40 (UTC) Highly recommended: cardamon bun and pourover at Café Olive in Quebec City discovered in The Sprudge Guide To Coffee In Quebec City, Aug 2025

  • Should have went back and had an espresso and another 3 buns :-) !

QUOTE

  • Read the whole thing for other great recommendations:Highly recommended: cardamon bun and pourover at Café Olive in Quebec City discovered in The Sprudge Guide To Coffee In Quebec City, Aug 2025

Many customers rave about their cardamom buns that pair well with a flat white but, much like their coffee program, their food focus is very minimalist. You can also ask for a V60 made to order, and for those seeking a non-coffee option, their citrus iced matcha is a popular choice. Owner Sami Boudaya and the team are always super friendly and accommodating, always with a smile. This is a real gem.

Café Olive is located at 1190-A Av. Cartier, Québec. Follow them on Instagram.
